title: EmDash refuses content writes before the site when Tracy cannot confirm the site write lease, while waiting for a real holder still works
steps: S1: in the EmDash tool handler, attempt a content_update when lease acquisition returns 503, 404, HTTP 200 without ok:true, or a network error.
S2: attempt the same write while another conversation holds the lease, then after it becomes free.
expect: S1: each call returns LEASE_DOOR_UNAVAILABLE and the site's MCP receives zero content_update calls.
S2: the held call returns SITE_BUSY without a site write; after the lease is free the write succeeds once.
evidence: The 8 November 2026 AI audit found emdashWriteLease logging an unavailable lease then returning null, allowing an EmDash write without serialization.
fence: A direct EmDash write requires a confirmed site_write_lease from tracy-web before any MCP or script write reaches the site.

cmd: --test-name-pattern=unavailable or unconfirmed EmDash lease|every EmDash write road
tests: 🔒 Q1: an unavailable or unconfirmed EmDash lease refuses the write before it reaches the site
🔒 Q1: every EmDash write road takes the lease first
